arguments.summary: Fixed `slugify` in `textkit/slug.py` by adding two steps after the initial regex substitution: (1) collapse multiple consecutive hyphens into one with `re.sub(r"-+", "-", text)`, and (2) strip leading/trailing hyphens with `text.strip("-")`. This ensures `"Hello,  World!"` returns `"hello-world"` and `"--a--b--"` returns `"a-b"`.
